# Library / browser / search sweep. Adjust the nav path to a real music folder.
# Linux: any readable dir. Android: a MediaStore-backed path (/sdcard/Music).
nav /home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp
inspect
shoot browser_root
up
inspect
# browser presentation: swipe-up (B-032/B-033) — screenshot collapsed + expanded
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=browserPresentation value=swipe_up
shoot browser_swipeup
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=browserPresentation value=fixed
shoot browser_fixed
overflows
